verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, mechanics, and race restrictions. Preserve unsupported stamina, probability, and finish fields as null.
research_scope: Shining Slash — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Xenoverse 2 acquisition reports.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Shining Slash was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Shining Slash as a Strike Super and a Human/Saiyan skill.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation lists Parallel Quest 38 — Power Teams as the acquisition route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ38 route but do not provide sufficiently explicit evidence that the skill itself requires the Ultimate Finish.

records.name: Shining Slash
records.skill_description: A sword-based Strike Super that slashes the opponent; holding the input charges the attack and allows the user to move directly toward the targeted opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference identifies a single-hit sword slash with an extended-range charge behavior. Holding the input causes the user to teleport/gap-close to the locked-on target before the slash.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ38 is the canonical Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. The skill is restricted to Human and Saiyan CaCs when equipped by the Future Warrior.
records.pve_notes: PQ38 acquisition; exact RNG behavior is unresolved and no unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pvp_notes: Long-range charged gap-closing Strike Super. Detailed frame and matchup behavior is version-sensitive and is not encoded as unsupported numeric data.
